verdict.rationale: SerpApi's API reference pages document each engine's parameters and link directly to a first-party playground offering "a live and interactive demo" (serpapi-docs-30). A script builder generates starter code (serpapi-gh-7), and the reference is also served as LLM-friendly markdown (serpapi-probe-2). Missing for 10: detail on what the playground lets you run or edit beyond a single mention, no OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all candidate paths 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
